hooks.name: Validate JSON on save
hooks.description: Validates JSON syntax on save to prevent malformed config or payload files.

action.command: cd /Users/udingethe/Dev/kleros && cat "$KIRO_FILE_PATH" | python3 -m json.tool > /dev/null 2>&1; if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "INVALID JSON: $KIRO_FILE_PATH" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
